content.title: Is Dunkin' Open On Easter? Details on 2026 Holiday Hours
content.text: Got a hankering for your favorite coffee drink this Easter? If so, you may be wondering if your local Dunkin' will be open for business on Sunday.Given that Easter is one of the biggest holidays on the Christian calendar, many retailers, grocers and restaurants are closed in observance of the April holiday. It's also a busy travel day since many people hit the road to visit friends, family and relatives for Easter brunch or dinner. Depending on what you've got going on this weekend, a trip to Dunkin' to get your daily dose of caffeine may be on the to-do list. If that's the case, you may be wondering whether Dunkin' stores and drive-thrus will be open on Easter this year. For the most up-to-date information on Dunkin' hours on Sunday, April 5, TODAY.com reached out to the coffeehouse chain for all the details. See below to find out everything you need to know to get your cup of joe or anything else you're craving from Dunkin' this Sunday. You'll also find a list of restaurants open to ensure that whatever you're doing this Easter, your plans go off without a hitch. Is Dunkin’ Open on Easter Sunday 2026? If you’re headed to Dunkin’ this Easter, a spokesperson tells TODAY.com the following: “Dunkin‘ store hours vary by location. While many Dunkin’ locations will be open on Easter, we encourage our guests to check the Dunkin‘ Mobile App to confirm if their local store is open before visiting.”You can also confirm local hours on the Dunkin' store locator, which you'll find right here.Restaurants Open on Easter 2026Along with many Dunkin’ locations, see below for a list of restaurants that will be open on Sunday, April 5. Bob Evans: Restaurants will be open on Easter. Hours may vary by location. Find local hours here. Bonchon: Restaurants will be open during normal business hours. Find local hours here. Burger King: Many Burger King restaurants will be open on Easter. Customers are encouraged to confirm hours ahead of going. Find local hours here. Chili’s: Restaurants will be open during normal business hours. Find local hours here. Denny’s: Restaurants will be open during normal business hours. Find local hours here. Krispy Kreme: Stores will be open. Hours may vary by location and may be adjusted. Find local hours here. McDonald's: Most restaurants will be open during normal business hours. Confirm local hours before going. Find local hours here. Wendy’s: Many locations will be open on Easter. Since hours can vary by location, customers should confirm hours before going.
